posts.title: Hello World
posts.content:
# Hello World

Welcome to **xBlog**, a tiny blog engine written in *xlang*.

This post exercises the markdown renderer end-to-end.

## Features

- HTTP server with `template`-based HTML
- Markdown rendering with code blocks
- JSON persistence

Inline code: `print("hi")`. Link: [xlang repo](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode).

## Code Block

```
func main(...) as int
    println("hello from xlang")
    return 0
end
```

That's all for now.

---

End of post.
